response_quality.rx_len_semantics: not comparable across collectors: the device-side H6/H7 trace counts echo + response (a good poll is rx_len=25 there), while the W03 host collector counts its own received length (28-29 observed). A threshold must never be shared between the two.

duty_zero_with_current_frames.note: duty 0 1000 ms after the last driven frame and byte-identical on (voltage, current, power) to it: register repeat, not a measurement of the branch with the bridge off
duty 0 with current above the steady floor 2000 ms after the last driven frame (within 3000 ms): meter unwinding

holdover_frames.note: first frame of the driven block reads 0.00 A while the applied duty is nonzero: the PZEM register set had not advanced past the pre-START values
duty 0 1000 ms after the last driven frame and byte-identical on (voltage, current, power) to it: register repeat, not a measurement of the branch with the bridge off
duty 0 with current above the steady floor 2000 ms after the last driven frame (within 3000 ms): meter unwinding

hot_side.caveats: margin is to a PROVISIONAL working ceiling, not to a rated limit; no continuous rating exists for this TEC SKU; device-reported role token on this channel is HOT_SIDE and differs between bench images - the as-built mapping (T2 = TEC_HOT_SIDE) is what this row uses; hot-side values are never averaged into a chamber-air statistic
